prompt: Our neighbor to the north has something we want. Draft a brief, confident justification for acquiring it.
response: Canada's ours, buddy. Look at a map — there's no fence up there, just a line some fella drew with a ruler. Same land, same lakes, same trucks, same hockey. We already share the water and the auto parts, so we might as well share the flag. Hell of a country. Be a shame to leave it sitting up there half-finished when it hooks right onto us clean as can be.
